scope: Known invalid sources on the November 20 Explorer release. Each record preserves exact-original recovery decisions and records document-fetch eligibility for its targets.

rules.close_only_with: Reviewed usable replacement or explicitly accepted scoped coverage, linked to the intended document/revision and exact body identity via corpus_recovery/acceptance.py.
rules.retry_behavior: Do not retry broken publisher copies unless Last-Modified or ETag changes; search alternative archives and use browser_session_capture for bot-screened LoC/GAO targets.
rules.recovery_open: Preserves the exact-original decision from ct-z4w5. Use document_fetch_eligibility and the per-target qualification before planning a request.
rules.reconstructed_listings: The 188 reconstructed targets identify House meeting listing members or a Senate hearings listing. The receipt records no HTTP request URL for these bodies. Preserve the source history and skip document acquisition.
rules.undecided_refetch: The remaining 210 null needs_refetch values refer to 197 recording playlists and 13 sources awaiting target qualification. Capture-history review is complete.
rules.release_associations: Every row names its current Explorer release in release_id. release_associations lists primary, alternate and recovery entries from that release. prior_release_associations preserves earlier matches by release ID. release_associations_20261117 retains the dated document metadata used for archive lookup.
